comment: Pronunciation pins applied by audio/tts.py before each request (whole words, case-sensitive, longest key first). A string value is an ARPAbet pin (CMUdict phonemes, stress digits 0/1/2) sent as <|phoneme_start|>...<|phoneme_end|>; {"phonemes": ...} is the same with notes; {"say": ...} replaces the word by a respelling. Entries listed in 'check' need the user's or the supervisors' preferred pronunciation: changing an entry re-synthesises (and re-bills) only the paragraphs that contain the word. Gissinger is pinned in French (BRIEF D12). Supervisors' names are not narrated (BRIEF D6), so they have no entry.
